sources.headless: DESIGN (DECISIONS X-65): game rhythm ~10 fouls and ~2 yellow cards per played match (whatever its duration), the same rates as QuickSim; dotnet/MatchReport prints the 200-match report. Penalties: real leagues ~0.25-0.35 per match (ESTIMATE, no primary source). Offsides: real 3-4 per match (user spec, docs/REFERENCES.md) scaled by the rhythm of X-65 to ~1.2-1.6; A8a reaches ~0.7 with close calls only, runs in behind arrive in A9 (X-68)
sources.penalty: Real-football conversion ~75-80% (ESTIMATE, widely reported; no primary source). Isolated penalties of the vertical slice's strong side against the weak keeper (dotnet/MatchReport --penalties)
sources.strictReferee: Test-only discipline (match_rules.json) that books nearly every foul, so second yellows and dismissals happen in every match
